links.outcome: Readability and required literacy level of AI answers versus guidelines for GDM questions
links.effect: Guideline answers were more accessible to the general audience and easiest to read; ChatGPT and Bard required higher literacy levels, with Bard the most challenging text.
links.quote: The medical guidelines provided more accessible answers for the general audience, while ChatGPT and Bard required higher literacy levels.

screen.reason: Evaluates the quality, readability, and completeness of ChatGPT and Bard responses to gestational diabetes questions compared to clinical guidelines, without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
